name: manual_3ae472
claim: Explicitly bridge sibling repositories into PYTHONPATH for cross-repo test suites in detached worktrees: oramasys tests require dispatch_wire from phylax/src which is absent from standard system environments.

decisions.notes: Running revocation harness tests in clean or detached worktrees failed on missing dispatch_wire until PYTHONPATH=src:<phylax_root>/src was provided.

rationale: Running revocation harness tests in clean or detached worktrees failed on missing dispatch_wire until PYTHONPATH=src:<phylax_root>/src was provided.
